# commercetools_connect_deployment (Resource)

A deployment of a commercetools Connect connector to the Project: its applications built and run by commercetools, with the configuration given here.

Terraform uploads no code. The connector names a Git repository and tag; Connect builds the applications from that tag. This resource installs the connector in the Project with its configuration; roll out new releases from CI/CD with the commercetools CLI, which publishes a new tag and redeploys with `--updateConnector`, and add `connector_version` to `ignore_changes`.

Creating one waits until Connect has deployed it, which usually takes several minutes. A deployment that fails stays in the state as tainted, so the next apply replaces it. A change to the configuration or the connector version redeploys it in place; a change to the connector, the type or the region replaces it.

Secured configuration values are never returned. Terraform keeps the configured values in state, cannot detect that they were changed outside of Terraform, and sends them again on every redeploy. After an import, set them before the first apply, or the redeploy sends none.

See also the [Connect deployments documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/connect/deployments).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "algolia_admin_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "commercetools_connect_deployment" "search_sync" {
  key           = "search-sync"
  connector_key = commercetools_connect_connector.search_sync.key
  region        = "europe-west1.gcp"
  type          = "production"

  # The first deployment uses the version Terraform published. Releases after
  # that are rolled out from CI/CD with the commercetools CLI, so the version
  # is ignored from then on:
  #
  #   commercetools connect connectorstaged update --key evolve-search-sync --repository-tag v1.1.0
  #   commercetools connect connectorstaged publish --key evolve-search-sync
  #   commercetools connect deployment redeploy --key search-sync --updateConnector
  connector_version = commercetools_connect_connector.search_sync.published_version

  global_standard_configuration = {
    CTP_REGION = "europe-west1.gcp"
  }

  application {
    name = "indexer"
    standard_configuration = {
      ALGOLIA_APP_ID = "MYAPPID"
    }
    secured_configuration = {
      ALGOLIA_ADMIN_KEY = var.algolia_admin_key
    }
  }

  application {
    name     = "reindex"
    schedule = "0 3 * * *"
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [connector_version]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the deployment.
- `region` (String) Region to deploy to, such as `europe-west1.gcp`.

### Optional

- `application` (Block List) Configuration of one of the connector's applications, named as in its `connect.yaml`. Deploy at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--application))
- `connector_id` (String) ID of the connector to deploy. Conflicts with `connector_key`.
- `connector_key` (String) Key of the connector to deploy. Conflicts with `connector_id`.
- `connector_staged` (Boolean) Deploy the connector's previewable staged version instead of the published one. Requires `type = "preview"`.
- `connector_version` (Number) Version of the connector to deploy. Defaults to its current version, and then holds the version that runs. When releases are rolled out with the commercetools CLI (`commercetools connect deployment redeploy --updateConnector`), the recommended way, add it to `ignore_changes`. Raising it redeploys in place, moving the deployment to the connector's latest published version, which must be this one.
- `deploy_timeout` (String) How long to wait for a deployment, redeployment or undeployment, as a duration such as `45m`. Defaults to `30m`.
- `global_secured_configuration` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret values for the connector's global configuration, shared by every application.
- `global_standard_configuration` (Map of String) Plain values for the connector's global configuration, shared by every application.
- `skip_scripts_on_redeploy` (Boolean) Skip the connector's `postDeploy` and `preUndeploy` scripts when a change redeploys it.
- `type` (String) `sandbox` or `production` for a published connector, `preview` for a staged one. Defaults to `sandbox`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the deployment.
- `status` (String) Status of the deployment, `Deployed` once it runs.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the deployment, raised by every redeploy.

<a id="nestedblock--application"></a>
### Nested Schema for `application`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the application, as in the connector's `connect.yaml`.

Optional:

- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule of a `job` application, overriding the one in `connect.yaml`.
- `secured_configuration` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret values, read by the application as environment variables.
- `standard_configuration` (Map of String) Plain values, read by the application as environment variables.

Read-Only:

- `topic` (String) Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic of an event application, once deployed.
- `url` (String) URL of a service application, once deployed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A deployment is imported using its key.
#
# Secured configuration values are not returned by the API. Set them in the
# configuration before the first apply after an import: a redeploy sends the
# configured values, and none when they are left out.
terraform import commercetools_connect_deployment.search_sync search-sync
```
